# A project with no tracker, no forge and no beads. The command is obeereal, the real composition root.
# The items are in local.db. The fake claude and the real git are the only programs on PATH.
# The first review asks for changes, the fix commits, and the second review approves. The last step pushes the branch into the source repository.
isolate
exec git --version
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt Makefile
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

# The workflow, its four prompts and its project file are the files of examples/local. Only the source of the project differs: it names the repository of the script.
example local/workflow.star
example local/prompts/plan.md
example local/prompts/implement.md
example local/prompts/review.md
example local/prompts/fix.md
example local/project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
subst fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/claude

exec obeereal check workflow local/workflow.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec obeereal item add local add-greeting --title 'Add a greeting' --body-file body.txt
stdout 'added item add-greeting to project local'

exec obeereal run add-greeting local --workflow local/workflow.star
stdout 'item add-greeting finished'

exec obeereal status
stdout 'add-greeting-r1\tdone'

# The steps ran in order: one plan, one implement, two reviews and one fix between them.
cmp calls.log expected-calls.log

# The run is done, so the claim row is free. The harness runs under umask 000, so the file is private only because the store asks for 0600.
noclaims local
mode state/local.db 600

# The branch is in the source repository, with the commits of the agent. The checkout of the user has no change.
exec git -C origin rev-parse --verify refs/heads/add-greeting
exec git -C origin show add-greeting:greeting.txt
stdout 'hello'
exec git -C origin show add-greeting:fixed.txt
stdout 'fixed'
exec git -C origin status --porcelain
! stdout .

-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- body.txt --
Add a file with a greeting.
-- origin/Makefile --
check: ; @:
-- expected-calls.log --
plan
implement
review
fix
review
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
# The fake claude. It names the step from the first words of the shipped prompt, and a review prompt holds the file for the verdict.
# Each call adds the step to calls.log. A call leaves its work as a commit in the folder where it runs.
step=
write=
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case $line in
    'Read the task below'*) step=plan ;;
    'Make the change that'*) step=implement ;;
    'Review the last commit'*) step=review ;;
    'Fix each problem'*) step=fix ;;
    'Write the verdict to '*) write=${line#Write the verdict to }; write=${write%% as JSON*} ;;
  esac
done
echo "$step" >> "@WORK@/calls.log"
commit() { git add "$1" && git -c user.name=agent -c user.email=agent@example.com commit -q -m "$step"; }
case $step in
  implement) echo hello > greeting.txt && commit greeting.txt ;;
  fix) echo fixed > fixed.txt && commit fixed.txt ;;
  review)
    if [ -e "@WORK@/reviewed" ]; then verdict=approve; else verdict=changes; : > "@WORK@/reviewed"; fi
    printf '{"verdict":"%s","mechanism":""}\n' "$verdict" > "$write"
    ;;
esac
echo '{"type":"result","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
